UI_portal_Intro: Real towns made with Portal. Enable one at a time; they share the same spot in the world.
UI_portal_LinkCopied: Link copied. Paste it into your browser:\n%1
UI_portal_NoTowns: No Portal towns installed yet. Subscribe to one on the Workshop, or make your own with Portal.
UI_portal_Step1: Install KnoxMap once, then download and run Portal (Windows).
UI_portal_Step2: Search for a town, pick a size and press Generate & Play.
UI_portal_Step3: Enable the town under Mods, then start a New Game and pick it as your spawn region.
UI_portal_Download: Portal is free. Download it here:
UI_portal_OneAtATime: Enable only one Portal town at a time: they all sit at the same spot in the world.
UI_portal_HowToPlay: Start a New Game and pick this town as your spawn region. A map only appears in a new world.
UI_portal_HowToEnable: Enable it under Mods, then start a New Game and pick it as your spawn region.
